title: Eatery Plan Object State v1.5.0
description: Live state of any plan object (component): active/passive, how far it is open, device power. Kept outside the plan like table state; objectId refers to an id in the plan. Values here override the plan's defaults.

extensions.description: Application-specific or forward-compatible data. Keys must be namespaced (e.g. 'acme.priceTier'). Clients ignore unknown keys and preserve them on save.

active.description: false = passive: closed, out of service or disabled.

open.description: 0 = closed, 1 = fully open. Pergola louvers / retractable roofs, folding and sliding glass walls, doors and windows.

mode.description: Free-form device mode, e.g. cooling, heating, fan.
